blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Tourism (DOT) has launched a public data dashboard that allows users to track the Philippines’ tourism performance, including visitor arrivals, outbound travel, economic contribution and employment. The Philippine Tourism Data Dashboard, launched Wednesday, provides visitor arrival data dating to 2010 and outbound traveler figures from 2023 to 2025, according to the DOT. Users can view arrivals by month and year, compare figures across periods and see the Philippines’ leading source markets and monthly arrivals from the top 20 countries of origin.
